note: Accepted findings for the visual audit's --gate. Every entry here is a problem someone has looked at and decided to live with for now, so a run that finds nothing new passes. Empty means the audit is clean: contrast failures, page errors, skipped captures, horizontal overflow and unlabelled controls are all at zero. Add an entry only with --update-baseline, and review the resulting diff in the PR. Keys identify the element (route, viewport, theme, state, tag, class, required level) and deliberately exclude measured values, so retuning a colour does not read as a new regression; `fingerprint` records the severity that was accepted.
